content.comment_body: Hello, I'm unable to link a float data type using [product_name] Advanced [version_no]. There doesn't seem to be a float option for the [product_name] connection. Does this work in newer versions like [version_no]?

For your situation with block [article_no], the [product_name] writes the float value into VM memory using 4 bytes starting at address 58. So, it's either VD58 = VB58+VB59+VB60+VB61 or possibly VW58 + VW60. In the tag table of [product_name], select the datatype 'Real' and use the address 'VD58'.

analysis.insight_summary: The user encounters problems when linking float variables between [product_name] and [product_name] Advanced [version_no] due to missing support for float datatype in the connection settings. This restricts direct transfer of floating-point values, pointing to gaps in datatype compatibility and possible discrepancies in functionality across different [product_name] versions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates being able to directly link float variables between [product_name] and [product_name] without encountering datatype issues, especially in [version_no] or newer releases.
